### Bio:

I am a PhD student in the Department of Biostatistics at UCLA. I previously completed my MS in the same department and my BA at The University of Chicago. My research interests include Bayesian transfer learning and causal inference. In my free time, I enjoy bouldering outside, reading, and watching movies.
